detailed_descriptions_html.en:
An incremental tower defense game where the enemy isn't just a wave, but a large-scale, dynamic physics-based simulation. Defend yourself from a relentless onslaught of insects with an arsenal of turrets, squads of soldiers, traps and walls. Shape the battlefield, control the advance of the swarm, and upgrade your defenses to survive.

A Physics-Driven Swarm

The bugs aren’t just following waypoints on a fixed course. They are thousands of individual bodies that collide with each other, pile up against your walls, squeeze through tight gaps and flow around obstacles.

Shape the Battlefield

Turrets on the rock. Walls and squads are sitting on the open floor. The two systems work together and you get to choose where the swarm can go, rather than simply dealing damage.

Know Your Enemy

Face the varied swarm: basic Grunts, speedy Runners, armored Brutes and deadly Elites. Watch out for Flyers flying over your ground defenses. Always take the Warden first. It puts up a huge shield for the bugs around it.

Features

  • Physics-based swarms that cluster, collide and flow like a fluid

  • Build walls and turrets to change the battlefield on the fly

  • Deploy and lead squads of soldiers to hold the line

  • 20+ unique turrets and traps, including Tesla chaining and Gravity Fields

  • 100+ nodes in the tech tree with live upgrades that are effective immediately

  • Conquer 20+ unique levels, each featuring distinct tactical challenges

  • Fight a wide range of threats including Flyers and Wardens that throw shields
